decisive_items: Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min
Superiorly directed P waves (negative in leads II, III, and aVF)
Long RP interval (RP interval > PR interval)
response.rationale: The ECG pattern is diagnostic of atrial tachycardia, with a regular narrow-complex tachycardia, superior P-wave axis, and long RP interval. COVID-19 is a likely trigger but not the arrhythmia itself.
